achievements.name: Egg Toss
achievements.detail: Swallow something and throw the egg it becomes to hit a target.

achievements.name: Smiley Flower
achievements.detail: Pick up a Smiley Flower while exploring a crafted course.

achievements.name: Next Area
achievements.detail: Pay Smiley Flowers to a Blockafeller to open the path into another part of the island.

achievements.name: Flip Side
achievements.detail: Turn a course card over and play through the cardboard back of that stage.

achievements.name: Poochy Pups
achievements.detail: Find all three Poochy Pups hiding on a course's flip side.

achievements.name: Bonus Flower
achievements.detail: Round up the Poochy Pups and reach the flip-side goal quickly enough for an extra Smiley Flower.

achievements.name: Capsule Spin
achievements.detail: Spend coins in a capsule machine and take the costume that pops out.

achievements.name: Scrap Boss
achievements.detail: Beat a world boss built out of craft materials and clear that stretch of the island.

achievements.name: Co-op Clear
achievements.detail: Reach a course goal with a second Yoshi helping out.

achievements.name: Front Five
achievements.detail: Collect the five Smiley Flowers hidden on the front of a single course.

achievements.name: Gem Return
achievements.detail: Win a boss fight and bring back a gem belonging to the Sundream Stone.

achievements.name: Full Bouquet
achievements.detail: Collect every Smiley Flower hidden across the fronts and backs of the courses.
